scope: GT-BE19000AI BCM side, deployed kernel8-ui1; verification only; SL1680 AI board excluded

verdict.overall: partial: ARM64 native time64 works in tested paths; ARM32 compat time64 syscall ABI absent
verdict.zh_TW: 目前 kernel8 原生 arm64 已通過 time64 實測；armel／armhf 缺少新版 time64 系統呼叫，尚不符合完整混合 ABI 使用者空間的需求。

device.execution: Direct real-hardware execution over SSH; no QEMU-user, no syscall interposition

native_arm64.enosys_explanation: io_pgetevents is disabled by CONFIG_AIO=n; not a time width failure
native_arm64.file_timestamp_roundtrip: passed exact seconds and nanoseconds using utimensat and statx on an immediately unlinked private temporary file
native_arm64.limits: Dispatch-only invalid-input tests do not prove full semantics for every interface; clock_settime and clock_adjtime deliberately not invoked; no claim of full modern glibc/systemd compatibility

arm32_compat.CONFIG_COMPAT_32BIT_TIME: y; preserves the old 32-bit-time ABI, does not add new time64 entry points

real_glibc_runtime.origin: Existing BE98 builds copied and stripped into isolated temporary directories
real_glibc_runtime.meaning: libc current-time fallback works but does not supply missing kernel time64 functionality
real_glibc_runtime.runtime_resolution: Explicit isolated loader and library path; hashes matched; stock libc/loader not replaced
real_glibc_runtime.probe_exit_status_note: Exit 0 with --expect-eoverflow means the expected limitation was confirmed, not that time64 support passed

followup_required_for_full_arm32_time64: Backport the Linux 5.1-era ARM32 time64 syscall ABI and the associated compat handlers/conversions; entry numbers alone are insufficient.
Preserve legacy time32 interfaces for ASUS/Broadcom blobs; do not simply disable CONFIG_COMPAT_32BIT_TIME.
Review ancillary timestamp interfaces (SO_TIMESTAMP_NEW, SO_TIMESTAMPNS_NEW, SO_TIMESTAMPING_NEW) and old stat ABI boundaries separately.
Repeat real hardware tests for both armel and armhf plus native ARM64 regression, including positive future-time behavior after the backport.

references.relevance: _TIME_BITS=64 requires _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64; traditional32bit APIs can fall back to legacy syscalls.
Author tag lists time64 syscall ABI additions for32bit architectures. Final numbering cross-checked with installed UAPI.

audit_status_note: Supporting source and build audits describe their own static stages; this historical kernel8 report records the later completed hardware runs. Kernel9 follow-up is recorded separately in reports/kernel9/hardware-acceptance.json.
